## Triage Guidelines

### 🟡 Keep
- File provides unique value
- Should be linked from hub or canonical pages
- Add to REFERENCES_MAP if appropriate

### 🟢 Merge
- Content duplicates existing docs
- Can be incorporated into canonical page
- Create redirect stub if heavily referenced

### 🔵 Archive
- Historical/deprecated content
- Move to `archive/` directory
- Add entry to archive index
